title: Pure conduct outranks spiritual display.
summary: The highest religion is the Lord's Name, pure conduct, and the cleansing of the mind in holy company. Let the Lord's Name and pure conduct remain one.
takeaway: Let the Lord's Name and pure conduct remain one.
lifeApplication: Before the urge to look spiritual, pause and choose one act of apology, restraint, or service that keeps conduct pure today.

source.shortMeaning: The highest religion is the Lord's Name, pure conduct, and the cleansing of the mind in holy company.
source.lifeApplication: Before display begins, let holy company cleanse the mind and let pure conduct guide the body.
